title: pvFidesJSONReader
body:
## pvFidesJSONReader

Reads ADIOS2 data through Fides using an explicit Fides data model given as a JSON file, which describes how ADIOS2 variables form coordinates, cells and fields. The data model names one or more data sources, and DataSourcePath tells the reader which BP file or stream each source is. The output is a partitioned dataset collection. ParaView marks this route as mainly for debugging data models; use pvFidesReader when the BP output carries its own Fides metadata.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Without a DataSourcePath for each source named in the JSON model nothing can be read; give the source name exactly as in the JSON.
- ParaView's DataSourceIO is not exposed: it takes the memory address of a live ADIOS2 object, which Fides dereferences.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `FidesJSONReader`. Identity: `sources/FidesJSONReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ConverttoVTK` | Whether the data read by Fides are converted to native VTK datasets (true) or left in VTK-m form. Downstream ParaView filters generally need VTK datasets, so keep the default unless you know the following steps accept VTK-m data. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Createsharedpoints` | This property allows Fides to close gaps between blocks of structured grids by utilizing shared points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DataSourceEngines` | Flat list of [source name, ADIOS2 engine] pairs choosing the engine used for each Fides data source, e.g. ["source", "BPFile"]. ADIOS2 engines include BP file engines and the SST staging engine; choosing SST switches the reader to streaming mode. Unlisted sources use the BP file engine. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `DataSourcePath` | Flat list of [source name, path] pairs telling the reader where each data source named in the JSON data model is: a BP file or directory for file engines, or a stream name for staging engines, e.g. ["source", "/data/run/output.bp"]. Relative paths are resolved from the working directory of the Schemaxis process (in Studio, the directory it was launched from), not from the JSON file's folder; absolute paths avoid ambiguity. The value must be a constant. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldArrays` | This property lists which field arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property sets the Fides JSON data model filename. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `StreamSteps` | Reads the data as a stream, one step at a time as the writer releases it, instead of random access to all stored time steps. It is used for staging engines (SST) and BP5 streaming, and is switched on automatically when an SST engine is set. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "PrepareNextStep": {
    "command": "PrepareNextStep",
    "native": "PrepareNextStep"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {
    "DataSourceIO": "in-process memory address that the native reader dereferences; unsafe for authored input"
  },
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFidesJSONReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["PrepareNextStep"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
